# data.docker_container_logs

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads a container's logs (`GET /containers/{id}/logs`), like `docker container logs --timestamps`. `log_entries` holds one object per line (`timestamp`, `stream`, `source`, `message`) and `logs` the same lines as text. Output of containers without a TTY is demultiplexed into `stdout` / `stderr` entries; a TTY container's lines have stream `combined`. The read does not follow the log and keeps the last `tail` lines (default 1000).

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `container` | `string` | required |  |  | The container whose logs are read, by ID or name. |
| `container_id` | `string` | computed |  |  | ID of the container the logs were read from. |
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | sha256 of logs. |
| `details` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Add the extra attributes the log driver records (for example labels) to each message (Engine `details`). Default `false`. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version from GET /version. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion). |
| `id` | `string` | computed |  |  | Container ID (the same value as `container_id`). |
| `log_entries` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | One entry per log line in arrival order, read with timestamps=true and bounded by the tail/since inputs; `source` is the container name (without the leading "/"). Only `message` is sensitive (log lines can print secrets). |
| `logs` | `string` | computed |  | yes | The log entries as plain text, one line per entry: "<timestamp> <stream> <source> <message>". Sensitive: log lines can print secrets. |
| `since` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only lines at or after this time. Takes an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. `2026-01-02T15:04:05Z`) or a duration before now such as `42m` or `1h30m`, sent as the Engine's UNIX-timestamp `since`. Combined with `tail` when both are set. |
| `stderr` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Include standard error (Engine `stderr`). Default `true`. |
| `stdout` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Include standard output (Engine `stdout`). Default `true`. |
| `tail` | `number` | optional |  |  | Lines to keep from the end of the logs of each container, service or task (the Engine's `tail`). Default `1000`, so state cannot grow without bound; `0` reads none, and there is no "all". |
| `until` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only lines before this time (Engine `until`): an RFC 3339 timestamp, a UNIX timestamp or a duration before now such as `10m`. |

### `log_entries`

nested attribute, list(object). One entry per log line in arrival order, read with timestamps=true and bounded by the tail/since inputs; `source` is the container name (without the leading "/"). Only `message` is sensitive (log lines can print secrets).

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | `string` | computed |  | yes | Upstream `log line without the timestamp prefix and trailing newline`. Sensitive. |
| `source` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `Name (leading "/" removed)`. |
| `stream` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `multiplexed frame header stream type: 1 = stdout, 2 = stderr; a TTY stream is not multiplexed (the Engine merges stdout and stderr at the source), so it is "combined"`. |
| `timestamp` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `timestamps=true line prefix (RFC 3339 nano)`. |

## Example

```terraform
data "docker_container_logs" "web" {
  container = "web"
  tail      = 100
  since     = "15m"
  stderr    = true
}

# log_entries messages are sensitive: they can carry secrets the application printed.
output "web_errors" {
  value     = [for e in data.docker_container_logs.web.log_entries : "${e.timestamp} ${e.message}" if strcontains(e.message, "ERROR")]
  sensitive = true
}
```
